::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** [1865]  
**Manuscript:** MS fragment Charlotte Mitchell/13
:::

. . . [Barnacle](organizations/other_89.qmd) article rather in the style of the Spring of the poets, and we wanted you to laugh with us.  I think you know the [Gatty](people/person_549.qmd)s, so I conclude you do not want an autograph from that quarter.

I am glad [Dr Harris](people/person_629.qmd) was able to go to [George](people/person_625.qmd)’s wedding, but I shall be glad to hear that he is safe back again[^1]  Poor Hursley has been very forlorn all the winter but its [squire](people/person_669.qmd) came back last week, and its [Vicar](people/person_798.qmd) comes on the 10th

yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The Rev. Joseph Hemington Harris (1799/1800-1881), Vicar of Tor Mohun, Torquay, was married to Jane Yonge, sister of the Rev. John Yonge of Puslinch.  His son the Rev. George Collyer Harris (1833-1874) married Percy Primrose in London in 1865 (June 1865).
